title: Unit customer stories
description: Customer stories on a pale tinted band: a centred heading, a row of customer-name tabs on a hairline (inactive names faded to 40%), and one white card holding a lilac picture on the left and a statement, product pills, a quote and an avatar line on the right. The active tab's black underline fills over eight seconds, then the next story crossfades in; clicking a tab jumps to it. On phones the tabs scroll sideways and the picture sits on top.
notes: media slots: the story picture (522×480) and the 40px avatar
autoplay runs on the underline's CSS animation; with reduced motion stories only change on click
the white card sits on the muted band: under themes where card and muted match it still reads through bg-background
